unknown_partial_semantics.note: UNKNOWN is intentionally handled by the Scorecard adapter before ZEN evaluation; ZEN is not allowed to coerce missing domain measurements to zero.

lineage.note: Lineage is reconstructed from canonical KPI inputs by the adapter; ZEN is not the owner of Scorecard lineage.

contribution.note: Contribution details are reconstructed from canonical inputs and weights; the engine result is treated only as the arithmetic result.

version_isolation.note: Each evaluation compiles a decision from the supplied calculation definition. Scorecard definition/policy version binding remains domain-owned.

adapter_complexity.note: The adapter is small and candidate-specific, but it must construct a JDM graph and reconstruct domain metadata because ZEN does not own our Scorecard semantics.

dependency_cost.note: Pinned candidate-only dependency. The published Windows x86-64 wheel is 11.0 MB; Linux x86-64 is 10.7 MB. ZEN 2.1.2 is MIT licensed and ships prebuilt wheels.

operational_cost.note: Rust core with native Python bindings and prebuilt Windows/Linux/macOS wheels; no Rust toolchain is required for normal wheel installation. This is candidate evidence, not production deployment approval.

policy_resolution.note: The current ZEN adapter evaluates calculation primitives only. Policy rule ordering, MATCH/NO_MATCH/UNKNOWN semantics and applied-rule identity remain domain-owned and are not delegated to ZEN by this evaluation artifact.
